operation_mapping_rule: each command/query key is the sole application dispatch destination for that named contract; shared module ownership is allowed but no second module may independently implement the same operation authority

owns: Advanced Search SR proposal generation/population absence
ticket_import.sr_reappearance_reconcile job handler/keyset checkpoint recovery/per-SR internal command dispatch
all /api/v1/imports routes including the competing-attempt review fragment

dependency_rules: ticket_import may depend on LLD-01 runtime/UoW/audit/jobs, LLD-02 settings/reference matching, LLD-03 SR/RFC owner interfaces, LLD-05 WFM/Task owner interfaces and LLD-06 SLA/classification consequences only through declared interfaces.
LLD-04 never imports another packet's repositories or writes another packet's tables directly.
Parser modules cannot import domain mutation services; they emit immutable normalized evidence only.
HTTP route adapters call command/query services and never calculate source precedence, proposal eligibility or domain state.
Only repositories under ticket_import.repositories write LLD-04 tables; owning-domain mutations occur through provider interfaces inside the caller UnitOfWork.

ResolveWfmCompetingAttemptReview owns LLD-04 proposal/run/disposition orchestration only; all activity-lineage business mutation crosses WfmActivityReviewParticipant inside the same caller UnitOfWork.

The reappearance durable-job handler reads only immutable published run/observation evidence plus declared LLD-03 readers/providers, and resolves each warning through ServiceRequestImportMutationService in a separate replay-safe internal command; it never opens or parses a workbook.
